title: Explorer empty state
responsibility: Says that a list or screen has nothing to show at this revision, and why.

inputs.name: EmptyState.as
inputs.description: Optional semantic element. Defaults to p, with div for block content.

inputs.name: EmptyState.className
inputs.description: Optional existing owner classes. Defaults to ex-empty.

inputs.name: EmptyState.role
inputs.description: Optional semantic role. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting role.

inputs.name: EmptyState.id
inputs.description: Optional native id. Defaults to JavaScript undefined.

inputs.name: EmptyState.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting aria-label.

inputs.name: EmptyState.component
inputs.description: Optional owner attribution. Defaults to JavaScript undefined.

inputs.name: EmptyState.children
inputs.description: Required caller content. Rendering errors propagate without replacing or suppressing its values.

outputs.name: EmptyState
outputs.description: Semantic EmptyState markup retaining caller content, native accessibility and the selected existing treatment.

errors.name: Content rendering error
errors.description: Errors from the required content snippet propagate to the owner.
